name: Linux File Permissions
description: Ability to understand and manage permissions and ownership of files and directories in Linux.

evaluation_concepts.name: Permission Classes
evaluation_concepts.description: Understands the owner, group, and others permission classes.

evaluation_concepts.name: Read Write Execute
evaluation_concepts.description: Understands the meaning of read, write, and execute permissions.

evaluation_concepts.name: Numeric Permissions
evaluation_concepts.description: Understands numeric permission representation such as 755 and 644.

evaluation_concepts.name: chmod
evaluation_concepts.description: Understands how chmod is used to change file permissions.

evaluation_concepts.name: chown
evaluation_concepts.description: Understands how chown is used to change file ownership.

evaluation_concepts.name: Directory Permissions
evaluation_concepts.description: Understands how read, write, and execute permissions behave differently on directories.

evaluation_concepts.name: Security Implications
evaluation_concepts.description: Understands security risks and practical consequences of inappropriate file permissions.
